docs.text: Spoke with the Mayor of Two Harbors. The winds are still a major issue today with the fires up north, but we hope the rain will help tomorrow. This video is an incredible example of pilots taking water from Lake Superior to fight the fires.
Even when the great lakes are calm the wind still has teeth. ❄️
Perfect! Another Northerner gets it. But you have those Great Lakes modulating just a little? But certainly not easing the wind off those lakes... 🥶
